meta.title: Trader Joe's Family Dinner Planner
meta.storeNote: Trader Joe's product names and stock can vary by location. Verify availability before shopping.
rules: Frozen ingredients are allowed only when cooked as part of the dish
Recipes are mild by default and can be adjusted for adults

recipes.title: Garlic-Lime Shrimp Tacos
recipes.description: Cooked shrimp tacos with cabbage, avocado, lime, cilantro, and warm corn tortillas.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Shredded Green & Red Cabbage
Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Thaw shrimp under cold running water, pat dry, and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Sauté shrimp in olive oil with minced garlic for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until opaque and cooked through.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with shrimp, cabbage, avocado, cheese, cilantro, and lime.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve chopped shrimp, avocado, cheese, and soft tortilla separately. Keep cabbage and lime optional.

recipes.title: Beef & Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with cooked ground beef, black beans, and melted cheese.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Cuban Style Black Beans
Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Brown beef and diced onion in a large skillet.
Add taco seasoning, black beans, and 1/4 cup water; simmer until thickened.
Fill tortillas with beef mixture and cheese.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet until crisp on both sides and cheese melts.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve soft tortilla strips with beef, beans, cheese, and avocado. Use minimal taco seasoning in their portion.

recipes.title: Garlic Pork Noodles with Broccoli
recipes.description: Ground pork, noodles, broccoli, garlic, ginger, and a mild soy-sesame finish.
steps: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Brown pork with minced garlic and ginger.
Add broccoli and 1/4 cup water; cover until broccoli is tender.
Add noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onions; toss until hot.
recipes.toddlerTip: Reserve noodles, pork, and broccoli before adding soy sauce. Cut noodles shorter with kitchen shears.

recipes.title: Warm Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.description: Freshly cooked chicken breast, romaine, Parmesan, and warm tortillas.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Organic Free Range Boneless Skinless Thin Sliced Chicken Breast Fillets

steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and olive oil; cook in a skillet until it reaches 165°F.
Rest chicken for 3 minutes, then slice.
Toss chopped romaine with a small amount of Caesar dressing, Parmesan, and crushed croutons.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken and salad.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve plain chicken strips, tortilla, finely cut romaine, and Parmesan. Skip dressing and croutons.

recipes.title: Smash Burgers with Green Beans
recipes.description: Thin beef patties with cheddar, brioche buns, and sautéed French green beans.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Sliced Sharp Cheddar Cheese

steps: Sauté green beans with olive oil and a splash of water until tender.
Form beef into 8 loose balls and season with salt and pepper.
Smash on a very hot skillet; cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese, and cook 1 more minute.
Toast buns and serve with onion, ketchup, and mustard.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve a deconstructed plate with small burger pieces, soft green beans, and bun.

recipes.title: Lemon Shrimp Orzo
recipes.description: Orzo with garlic shrimp, spinach, lemon, chicken broth, and Parmesan.
steps: Boil orzo until tender; reserve 1/2 cup cooking water and drain.
Cook thawed shrimp with garlic in olive oil until opaque.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Toss in orzo, Parmesan, lemon zest, lemon juice, and enough pasta water to make a light sauce.
recipes.toddlerTip: Set aside plain orzo, spinach, and small shrimp pieces before adding lemon.

recipes.title: Chicken Caprese Pasta
recipes.description: Chicken, cavatappi, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella pearls, basil, and balsamic glaze.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Organic Free Range Boneless Skinless Thin Sliced Chicken Breast Fillets

steps: Boil cavatappi until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Sear seasoned chicken 3 to 4 minutes per side until 165°F; slice.
Cook garlic and tomatoes until tomatoes soften.
Toss pasta with chicken, tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, pasta water, and balsamic glaze.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve pasta, chicken, and soft tomatoes separately. Cut mozzarella pearls into quarters.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Chicken thighs, jasmine rice, egg, peas, carrots, ginger, garlic, and green onions.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs

steps: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions, then spread it out briefly to release steam.
Cook diced chicken thighs in a large braising pan until browned and 165°F; remove.
Scramble 3 eggs, then add peas, carrots, ginger, garlic, rice, chicken, green onions, and Soyaki.
Stir-fry until hot and evenly coated.
recipes.toddlerTip: Set aside chicken, egg, rice, peas, and carrots before adding Soyaki.

recipes.title: Loco Moco Beef Bowls
recipes.description: Beef patties over rice with mushroom-onion gravy and optional fried eggs.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions.
Mix beef with a small splash of Worcestershire, form 4 patties, and sear until cooked through.
Cook mushrooms and onion in the same pan; add broth and thicken with a cornstarch slurry.
Serve patties and gravy over rice. Add fried eggs for adults if desired.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve chopped beef, rice, and soft mushrooms with only a small amount of gravy.

recipes.title: Sausage, Gnocchi & Broccoli Skillet
recipes.description: Sweet Italian chicken sausage, potato gnocchi, broccoli, marinara, and mozzarella.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Sweet Italian Chicken Sausage
Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce
Trader Joe's Shredded Lite Mozzarella Cheese

steps: Slice sausage and brown in a large covered skillet; transfer to a plate.
Cook onion, garlic, and broccoli with a splash of water until broccoli is tender-crisp.
Add gnocchi, marinara, 1/2 cup water, and sausage; cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes.
Top with mozzarella, cover until melted, and serve.
recipes.toddlerTip: Cut gnocchi and sausage into small pieces. Cook broccoli until soft.

recipes.title: Tuscan Chicken Penne
recipes.description: Seared chicken thighs, spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, Parmesan, and penne in creamy garlic sauce.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs
Trader Joe's Sun-Dried Tomatoes in Olive Oil

steps: Boil penne until just shy of tender; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Season and sear chicken in an 8-quart braising pan until 165°F; remove and slice.
Cook garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Add 3/4 cup broth and 3/4 cup cream; simmer 3 minutes.
Add spinach, Parmesan, chicken, and penne. Use pasta water to loosen the sauce.
recipes.toddlerTip: Set aside plain penne, soft chicken pieces, and spinach before extra seasoning.

recipes.title: Beef & Black Bean Enchilada Skillet
recipes.description: Ground beef, black beans, corn tortillas, enchilada sauce, corn, and melted cheese.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Traditional Style Refried Beans
Trader Joe's Cuban Style Black Beans
Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Brown beef and onion in an oven-safe skillet.
Add black beans, frozen corn, and enchilada sauce; simmer 5 minutes.
Warm refried beans with a splash of water.
Layer torn tortillas, beans, beef mixture, and cheese. Cover 10 minutes, then broil until bubbling.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve soft tortilla, beans, beef, and cheese before any hot toppings.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo with Green Beans
recipes.description: Chicken thighs, orzo, green beans, lemon, Parmesan, and feta in one braising pan.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs

steps: Season and sear chicken in a braising pan; remove temporarily.
Cook garlic and orzo for 1 minute, then add 3 cups broth.
Nestle chicken and green beans into the orzo. Cover and simmer until chicken reaches 165°F and orzo is tender.
Finish with lemon zest, juice, Parmesan, and feta.
recipes.toddlerTip: Reserve plain orzo, chicken, and soft green beans before lemon and feta.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Salmon, Potatoes & Broccoli
recipes.description: Roasted salmon with baby potatoes, broccoli, lemon, olive oil, and Dijon.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast 20 minutes.
Add broccoli and salmon to the sheet pan.
Brush salmon with Dijon and lemon juice.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes more, until salmon flakes and potatoes are tender.
recipes.toddlerTip: Flake salmon carefully and check for bones. Serve with soft potato and broccoli pieces.

recipes.title: Coconut Shrimp Curry with Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Shrimp, sweet potatoes, spinach, coconut milk, yellow curry sauce, and jasmine rice.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Thai Yellow Curry Sauce

steps: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.
Sauté diced sweet potato and onion for 6 minutes.
Add coconut milk and curry sauce. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender.
Add shrimp and cook until opaque. Stir in spinach and finish with lime.
recipes.toddlerTip: Reserve sweet potato, rice, spinach, and shrimp before adding much curry sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Bolognese with Thin Spaghetti
recipes.description: Ground beef, mirepoix, garlic, tomato basil marinara, broth, and Parmesan.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce

steps: Boil spaghetti until al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Brown ground beef, then cook with mirepoix and garlic until soft.
Stir in tomato paste, marinara, and 1/2 cup broth; simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
Toss with pasta and Parmesan, adding pasta water as needed.
recipes.toddlerTip: Cut spaghetti short and serve with finely crumbled beef sauce.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples & Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Pan-seared pork chops with roasted sweet potatoes, apples, onion, and green beans.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Roast cubed sweet potatoes with olive oil for 25 to 30 minutes.
Sear pork chops until browned, then finish in the oven until they reach 145°F. Rest 5 minutes.
Cook apples, onion, and green beans in the pork skillet with Dijon and a splash of cider vinegar.
Serve pork with roasted sweet potatoes and apple-green bean mixture.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve finely cut pork, very soft sweet potato, peeled cooked apple, and tender green beans.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti with Beef & Spinach
recipes.description: Beef, ricotta, spinach, mozzarella, Parmesan, marinara, and baked ziti.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce
Trader Joe's Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil ziti until 2 minutes under package directions.
Brown beef and onion, add marinara and spinach, and cook until spinach wilts.
Mix ziti with sauce and ricotta. Transfer to baking dish and top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake uncovered 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
recipes.toddlerTip: Cool well and cut ziti into small, soft bites.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan with Spaghetti
recipes.description: Scratch-breaded chicken breast, marinara, mozzarella, Parmesan, and spaghetti.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Organic Free Range Boneless Skinless Thin Sliced Chicken Breast Fillets
Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce

steps: Heat oven to 400°F and boil spaghetti until al dente.
Dip chicken in beaten egg, then panko mixed with Parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Pan-fry until golden, top with marinara and mozzarella, and bake until chicken reaches 165°F.
Serve over spaghetti with additional warmed marinara.
recipes.toddlerTip: Cut chicken into very small pieces and serve with plain spaghetti and mild sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Meatballs with Creamy Polenta
recipes.description: Scratch-made beef meatballs in marinara over creamy Parmesan polenta.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce

steps: Combine beef, egg, panko, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper. Form 16 small meatballs.
Brown meatballs in a large skillet. Add marinara, cover, and simmer until meatballs reach 160°F.
Prepare polenta according to package directions and stir in Parmesan.
Serve meatballs and sauce over creamy polenta.
recipes.toddlerTip: Cut meatballs into tiny pieces and serve with soft polenta.

recipes.title: Classic Beef & Spinach Lasagna
recipes.description: Layered baked lasagna with beef, spinach, ricotta, marinara, mozzarella, and Parmesan.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce
Trader Joe's Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown beef and onion, then add marinara and spinach.
Layer sauce, oven-ready noodles, ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan in a baking dish.
Repeat layers, cover with foil, and bake 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.
recipes.toddlerTip: Let cool well, then cut into small soft squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore with Polenta
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken thighs braised with tomatoes, mushrooms, peppers, onion, and herbs.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs
Trader Joe's Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes

steps: Season chicken and brown skin-side down in an 8-quart braising pan; remove.
Cook mushrooms, peppers, onion, and garlic.
Add tomatoes and broth, return chicken, cover, and braise at 350°F for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cook polenta according to package directions and serve under the chicken.
recipes.toddlerTip: Remove chicken from bone and skin, then serve shredded chicken with soft polenta and vegetables.

recipes.title: Beef Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Ground beef and vegetables beneath scratch-made mashed potatoes, baked until golden.
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Brown beef with mirepoix. Add tomato paste, Worcestershire, peas, carrots, and broth; simmer until thick.
Transfer beef mixture to a baking dish and top with mashed potatoes.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes until the potatoes are golden.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve a cooled portion with mashed potato, finely crumbled beef, and soft vegetables.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Slaw
recipes.description: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with onion and apple cider vinegar, shredded for sandwiches.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Shredded Green & Red Cabbage

steps: Rub pork with brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place pork in a covered roasting pan with onion, vinegar, ketchup, Dijon, and 1/2 cup water.
Roast covered at 300°F for about 5 hours, until pork shreds easily.
Shred pork into its juices. Toss cabbage with vinegar and Dijon, then serve on toasted buns.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve tender pulled pork and bun without slaw or sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Carnitas Tacos
recipes.description: Pork shoulder braised until tender, shredded, and oven-crisped for tacos.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Shredded Green & Red Cabbage
Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Cut pork into 3-inch chunks and season with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add pork, onion, garlic, lime juice, and broth to an 8-quart braising pan.
Cover and gently braise at 300°F for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until fork-tender.
Shred pork on a sheet pan, spoon over reduced cooking liquid, and broil until crisp at the edges.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve tender shredded pork, cheese, and soft tortilla. Keep cabbage and stronger seasonings off their plate.

recipes.title: Mild Beef Birria Tacos
recipes.description: Chuck roast braised with seeded dried chiles, tomato, onion, garlic, and broth for mild, rich tacos.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes
Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Remove seeds from dried chiles for a mild result. Soften chiles in hot water.
Blend chiles with tomatoes, onion, garlic, and broth.
Sear chuck roast, add blended sauce and remaining broth, cover, and braise at 300°F for about 3 hours.
Shred beef. Dip tortillas lightly in cooking liquid, fill with beef and cheese, then crisp in a skillet.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve plain shredded beef, cheese, and soft tortilla. Do not use chile broth for the toddler portion.

recipes.title: Sunday Beef Ragù with Pappardelle
recipes.description: Chuck roast slowly braised in tomato sauce until it becomes a rich shredded-beef pasta sauce.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce

steps: Sear chuck roast in a Dutch oven or braising pan; remove temporarily.
Cook mirepoix, garlic, and tomato paste. Add marinara and broth.
Return beef, cover, and braise at 300°F for about 2 hours.
Shred beef into sauce. Cook pappardelle and finish with Parmesan.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve short-cut pasta with finely shredded beef and a modest amount of sauce.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Pork Ragù
recipes.description: Pork shoulder, fennel, tomato marinara, garlic, and rigatoni.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Tomato Basil Marinara Sauce

steps: Sear pork shoulder in a braising pan; remove temporarily.
Cook sliced fennel, onion, and garlic.
Add marinara and broth, return pork, cover, and braise at 300°F for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Shred pork, toss with cooked rigatoni, and finish with Parmesan.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve finely shredded pork with cut rigatoni and mild sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Barbacoa Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Chuck roast braised with citrus, cumin, onion, garlic, and broth, served over rice.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Mexican Style Shredded Cheese Blend

steps: Season and sear chuck roast with cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add onion, garlic, orange juice, lime juice, and broth.
Cover and braise at 300°F for about 3 hours until the beef shreds easily.
Cook rice and serve shredded beef with cheese.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve shredded beef and rice with cheese; keep citrus-heavy juices off the toddler plate if preferred.

recipes.title: Red Wine Pot Roast with Potatoes
recipes.description: Chuck roast braised with baby potatoes, carrots, onion, mushrooms, broth, and red wine.
steps: Sear chuck roast well in a Dutch oven or braising pan; remove temporarily.
Cook onion, mushrooms, and tomato paste. Add wine and broth.
Return beef with potatoes, carrots, and thyme.
Cover and braise at 300°F for 3 to 3 1/2 hours until fork-tender.
recipes.toddlerTip: Serve shredded beef with very soft carrots and potatoes. Use little or no wine-heavy sauce.

recipes.title: Braised Short Ribs with Parmesan Polenta
recipes.description: Beef short ribs braised in tomato, broth, red wine, onion, carrot, and herbs.

ingredients.product: Trader Joe's Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes

steps: Season and sear short ribs in a braising pan; remove.
Cook carrot, onion, and garlic. Add tomatoes, wine, and broth.
Return ribs, cover, and braise at 300°F for about 3 hours until meat falls from the bone.
Prepare polenta and stir in Parmesan. Serve ribs over polenta.
recipes.toddlerTip: Remove all bones and connective tissue. Serve finely shredded short rib over soft polenta.
